core_obligations: Reformulate by duality (proof lines 1848-1862): normalizing the dualizing complex of the base and using that a normal surface is Cohen-Macaulay, the dualizing complex of the source is a shift of the dualizing module; if the vanishing failed there would be a nonzero map from the first direct image to the residue field, equivalently a nonzero map from the derived pushforward of the dualizing complex to the residue field shifted by one.

Apply the dualizing functor (proof lines 1862-1876): taking the derived hom into the dualizing complex of the base turns that map into a nonzero map from the residue field shifted back into the derived pushforward of the structure sheaf; the two displayed computations, using the normalization of the dualizing complex and the identification of the dualizing complex of the source as the exceptional inverse image of the one of the base, show that the derived hom of the pushforward of the dualizing complex is the pushforward of the structure sheaf.

Conclude by the injectivity lemma (proof lines 1876-1880): a nonzero map from the residue field shifted into the derived pushforward of the structure sheaf would contradict the injectivity of the restriction of the first cohomology of the structure sheaf, so the first direct image of the dualizing module vanishes.
proof_roadmap: Normalize the dualizing complex and use Cohen-Macaulayness to reduce the vanishing to the absence of a nonzero map to the residue field.
Apply the dualizing functor and compute the two derived homs to produce a map from the residue field into the pushforward of the structure sheaf.
Rule the latter out by the injectivity of the restriction of the first cohomology.
difficulty_reason: The proposition proves that in the rational singularity situation, with the source normal and the base Nagata and admitting a dualizing complex, the first direct image of the dualizing module of the source vanishes (statement lines 1837-1846). The proof (proof lines 1848-1887) normalizes the dualizing complex, reduces a failure of vanishing to a nonzero map to the residue field, applies the dualizing functor with two displayed identifications to convert it into a map from the residue field into the pushforward of the structure sheaf, and excludes the latter by the injectivity of the restriction of the first cohomology. H3: a duality argument with two computations, written out in full.
